name: John J. Byrne Community Center
aliases: John J. Byrne Community Center – East
description: A nonprofit community center in Uniondale whose main building is called Byrne Center – East. It runs youth, senior and wellness programs and hosts dance classes, including Chicago Steppin' workshops, Haitian folklore dance and Afro-Caribbean dance sessions.

dancing.notes: Dancing here is mostly classes, not nights out with a band. The Steppers Society of NY teaches Chicago Steppin' (a partner dance) to beginners every other Wednesday evening in fall 2026, no partner needed. The center has also hosted hip-hop fusion, Haitian folklore and Afro-Caribbean wellness dance sessions. We could not confirm the room's size or floor type.
